paragraphs: Genworth Financial offers mortgage insurance products through its principal mortgage insurance subsidiaries. Genworth Financial also has start-up businesses whereby it offers fee-based services, advice, consulting and other aging-care services through CareScout Services and long-term care insurance products through CareScout Insurance.

In October 2025, Genworth Financial began selling an individual long-term care insurance product through its CareScout Insurance subsidiary, CareScout Insurance Company, and ceased sales of long-term care insurance products through Genworth Life Insurance Company ("GLIC"). GLIC and its subsidiaries, which are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Genworth Financial and are referred to together as "Closed Block" or our "legacy insurance subsidiaries," no longer offer or sell long-term care insurance, life insurance or annuity products. However, our legacy insurance subsidiaries will continue to service and manage their in-force blocks of business and may still issue a limited number of certificates under existing group long-term care insurance policies.

In connection with the cessation of sales through GLIC, beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, we changed our reportable segments to better align with how we currently manage our business. Under the new reporting structure, we operate our business through the following two reportable segments: Enact, comprised primarily of private mortgage insurance products, and Closed Block, comprised of long-term care insurance, life insurance and annuity products that were previously sold through our legacy insurance companies. In addition to our two reportable segments, we disclose other business activities and operating results in Corporate and Other, including our start-up businesses, CareScout Services and CareScout Insurance. We believe the change helps to enhance understanding of business performance and better aligns with our strategic priorities, including to maintain self-sustaining legacy insurance subsidiaries, which are managed on a standalone basis, as further described below. All prior period financial information has been recast to reflect the reorganized segment reporting structure.

Genworth Financial is the parent company of Enact Holdings, a leading provider of private mortgage insurance in the United States through its mortgage insurance subsidiaries. Enact Holdings is a public company traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market exchange under the ticker symbol "ACT." Genworth Financial maintains control of Enact Holdings through an indirect majority voting interest and accordingly, Enact Holdings remains a consolidated subsidiary of Genworth Financial. Enact Holdings and its mortgage insurance subsidiaries comprise, and can therefore generally be viewed as, our Enact segment, or commonly referred to as "Enact."

We continue to create shareholder value through Enact's growing market value and capital returns. Enact Holdings provided $407 million of capital returns to Genworth Holdings, Inc. ("Genworth Holdings"), our wholly-owned subsidiary, in 2025. We believe capital returns from Enact will continue to benefit our shareholders by funding our strategic initiatives, including new CareScout products and services, as well as share repurchases and opportunistic debt reduction. In September 2025, Genworth Financial announced that its Board of Directors had authorized a new share repurchase program under which Genworth Financial may purchase up to $350 million of its outstanding common stock. Since the initial authorization of Genworth Financial's share repurchase program in May 2022 and through February 20, 2026, we have repurchased $828 million worth of shares of Genworth Financial's common stock. For additional information on our share repurchase program, see "Part II—Item 7—Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Liquidity and Capital Resources."
We continue to drive future growth through CareScout with innovative, consumer-focused aging care services and funding solutions.

CareScout Services made significant progress during 2025, expanding its network of care providers ("CareScout Quality Network") to approximately 790 home care providers with more than 1,000 locations nationwide, and continued to see growth in the number of CareScout members who received first-time services from the network. Each CareScout Quality Network provider must meet CareScout Services' rigorous credentialing standards.

In October 2025, we acquired Seniorly, a leading platform with a large network of senior living communities that helps families with care planning and placement. The acquisition of Seniorly will expand the CareScout Quality Network to include assisted living communities and is expected to accelerate our expansion into the direct-to-consumer market, allowing us to connect consumers to the full range of CareScout Services offerings. Credentialing of Seniorly's major national senior living providers is underway and is expected to be complete by the end of 2026.

In addition to expanding the network, we are scaling other fee-based service offerings that we anticipate will generate a growing stream of recurring revenue, including our assessments service and our new Care Plans service, which launched in the second quarter of 2025. Our Care Plans offer a virtual or in-person care evaluation conducted by a licensed nurse and include a tailored aging-care strategy and a variety of local resources available to assist consumers.

Excluding the payment to acquire Seniorly, we contributed approximately $50 million to CareScout Services in 2025. The capital was used to scale our technology-enabled platform, along with marketing and brand awareness, as we seek to position the business for sustainable long-term growth. In 2026, we expect to continue to expand both the range of services offered by CareScout Services and the number of customers we serve. As the CareScout Quality Network continues to expand and brand awareness grows, we anticipate increased traction with consumers. In addition to the benefits to consumers, the discounts available through the network are expected to further mitigate risk in our long-term care insurance products in Closed Block by reducing claims costs over time.

We continue to advance our strategy to roll out innovative solutions to meet the growing demand for aging-care funding through CareScout Insurance. In October 2025, CareScout Insurance launched a new individual long-term care insurance product, Care Assurance, with the product live in 40 states as of February 20, 2026, and additional approvals pending. Care Assurance features customizable levels of coverage, inflation protection and individualized policyholder experiences. It also includes access to the CareScout Quality Network, along with an array of wellness support tools and care planning services. This product has been developed with conservative pricing assumptions designed to help mitigate the need for future premium rate increases. We are actively engaging with partners to broaden our distribution channels and plan to launch worksite and association group offerings later in 2026. While we expect adoption to build gradually, we believe this product creates significant value for both our customers and distribution partners.

We contributed $85 million to our CareScout Insurance subsidiary in 2025 to meet its regulatory capital requirements. Though actual funding may vary based on business performance and other developments, we anticipate smaller capital investments will be allocated to this business over the next few years.

While it will take time to scale these businesses, we believe our investments in CareScout Services and CareScout Insurance will drive sustainable future growth for Genworth and are aligned with our overarching priority to maximize long-term value for our shareholders. We will continue to strive to maintain a disciplined approach in our capital allocation strategy, balancing investments in CareScout growth initiatives with returning value to shareholders and opportunistically retiring debt.

We continue to actively manage our self-sustaining, customer-centric legacy insurance subsidiaries, comprising long-term care insurance, life insurance and annuity products included in our Closed Block segment. Our long-term care insurance multi-year in-force rate action plan continues to be our most effective tool in supporting this strategic priority. paragraphs: You should carefully consider the following risks. These risks could materially affect our business, results of operations or financial condition, cause the trading price of our common stock to decline materially or cause our actual results to differ materially from those expected or those expressed in any forward-looking statements made by us or on our behalf. These risks are not exclusive, and additional risks to which we are subject include, but are not limited to, the factors mentioned under "Cautionary note regarding forward-looking statements" and the risks of our businesses described elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025.

The following summarizes material risks to the Company and is qualified by the full description contained below. The occurrence of any of the following risks or of unknown risks and uncertainties may adversely affect our business, operating results and financial condition.
•New lines of business or new products and services, such as those we are pursuing with CareScout, may not be successful or may subject us to additional risks.

•We may be required to increase our reserves as a result of deviations from our estimates and actuarial assumptions or other reasons, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
•If the models used in our businesses are inaccurate, it could have a material adverse impact on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

•Our valuation of fixed maturity and equity securities uses methodologies, estimations and assumptions that are subject to change and differing interpretations which could result in changes to investment valuations that may materially adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

paragraphs: Genworth Financial 提供房貸保險產品透過其主要房貸保險子公司。Genworth Financial 也擁有新創事業，透過 CareScout Services 提供收費服務、建議、諮詢及其他長照服務，並透過 CareScout Insurance 提供長期照顧保險產品。

2025 年 10 月，Genworth Financial 開始透過其 CareScout Insurance 子公司 CareScout Insurance Company 売出個別長期照顧保險產品，並停止透過 Genworth Life Insurance Company ("GLIC") 売出長期照顧保險產品。GLIC 及其子公司為 Genworth Financial 全資擁有，並合稱為 "Closed Block" 或我們的 "遺產保險子公司"，不再提供或銷售長期照顧保險、人壽保險或年金產品。然而，我們的遺產保險子公司將繼續服務及管理其現存的業務塊，並可能仍會在現有團體長期照顧保險政策下發出有限數量的憑證。

配合 GLIC 停止銷售，自 2025 年第四季起，我們改變應報告分部，以更好地反映我們目前的業務管理方式。根據新的報告結構，我們透過以下兩個應報告分部運作業務：Enact，主要為私人房貸保險產品，以及 Closed Block，為先前透過我們遺產保險公司銷售的長期照顧保險、人壽保險及年金產品。除了我們的兩個應報告分部，我們在 Corporate and Other 部分披露其他業務活動及營運結果，包括我們的新創事業 CareScout Services 和 CareScout Insurance。我們認為此變更有助於增進對業務表現的瞭解，並更好地符合我們的戰略優先事項，包括維持自給自足的遺產保險子公司，這些子公司以獨立方式管理，如後文進一步說明。所有往期財務資訊已重新整理以反映重新組織的分部報告結構。

Genworth Financial 是 Enact Holdings 的母公司，Enact Holdings 是透過其房貸保險子公司在美國提供私人房貸保險的領導者。Enact Holdings 是一家上市公司，在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 交易所交易，股票代碼為 "ACT"。Genworth Financial 透過間接多數投票權控制 Enact Holdings，因此 Enact Holdings 剩餘為 Genworth Financial 的合併子公司。Enact Holdings 及其房貸保險子公司組成，並可視為我們的 Enact 分部，或常簡稱為 "Enact"。

我們持續透過 Enact 的成長市場價值及資本回報來創造股東價值。Enact Holdings 在 2025 年為 Genworth Holdings, Inc. ("Genworth Holdings")，我們的全資子公司，提供了 407 百萬美元的資本回報。我們認為 Enact 的資本回報將持續為股東帶來利益，用以資助我們的戰略計畫，包括新的 CareScout 產品與服務，以及股票回購與機會性的債務減少。2025 年 9 月，Genworth Financial 宣佈其董事會已批准新的股票回購計畫，允許 Genworth Financial 購買最多 350 百萬美元的現有普通股。自 2022 年 5 月首次批准 Genworth Financial 的股票回購計畫，至 2026 年 2 月 20 日，我們已回購價值 828 百萬美元的 Genworth Financial 普通股。有關我們股票回購計畫的更多資訊，請參閱 "Part II—Item 7—管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析—流動性與資本資源"。
我們持續透過 CareScout 推動未來成長，提供創新、以消費者為導向的長照服務與資金解決方案。

CareScout Services 在 2025 年取得重大進展，擴展其照護提供者網路 ("CareScout Quality Network") 至約 790 家居家照護提供者，擁有超過 1,000 個全美據點，並持續看到使用 CareScout 服務的會員數量成長。每家 CareScout Quality Network 提供者必須符合 CareScout Services 的嚴格認證標準。

2025 年 10 月，我們收購了 Seniorly，這是一家擁有大量長者居住社區網路的領導平台，協助家庭進行照護計畫與安置。收購 Seniorly 將擴展 CareScout Quality Network 以包含輔助生活社區，並預期加速我們進入直接對消費者市場的擴張，使我們能將消費者與 CareScout Services 的完整服務連結。Seniorly 的主要全國長者居住社區提供者的認證工作已展開，預計在 2026 年底前完成。
除擴充網路外，我們也在擴展其他收費服務項目，我們預期這些服務將產生日益增長的持續性收入流，包括我們的評估服務與我們於2025年第二季推出的Care Plans服務。我們的Care Plans服務提供經執照護理師進行的虛擬或現場護理評估，並包含個性化長者照護策略與多種當地資源，以協助消費者。

扣除支付取得Seniorly的費用後，我們於2025年向CareScout Services挹注約50 百萬美元。資金用於擴展我們的科技驅動平台，以及行銷與品牌認知度，以期將業務定位於可持續的長期成長。2026年，我們預期會持續擴展CareScout Services所提供的服務範疇與服務客戶數量。隨著CareScout Quality Network持續擴張與品牌認知度提升，我們預期將獲得消費者更多的關注。除對消費者有益外，透過該網路提供的折扣，預期將進一步降低我們長期照護保險產品在Closed Block中的風險，透過降低未來的賠償成本。

我們持續推動創新方案，以應對長者照護資金需求的成長，透過CareScout Insurance。2025年10月，CareScout Insurance推出新的個人長期照護保險產品Care Assurance，截至2026年2月20日，該產品已在40個州正式上線，並有額外的批准正在進行中。Care Assurance提供可客製化的保障層級、通貨膨脹保護與個性化的保單持有人體驗。該產品也包含對CareScout Quality Network的存取權，以及一系列健康促進工具與照護規劃服務。此產品已以保守的保費假設進行開發，旨在協助降低未來保費調漲的必要性。我們正積極與合作夥伴接觸，以拓展我們的銷售通路，並計畫於2026年後期推出企業與協會團體的銷售方案。雖然我們預期採用率將逐步提升，但我們相信此產品對我們的客戶與銷售合作夥伴皆具有顯著價值。
我們於2025年向CareScout Insurance子公司挹注85 百萬美元，以符合其監管資本需求。儘管實際資金可能因業務表現與其他發展而有所變動，我們預期未來幾年將分配較少的資本投資於此業務。
雖然這些業務的規模化需要時間，我們相信我們對CareScout Services與CareScout Insurance的投資將為Genworth帶來可持續的未來成長，並與我們整體的優先目標—為股東創造長期價值—一致。我們將持續努力維持資本配置策略的嚴謹性，平衡對CareScout成長計畫的投資與回饋股東價值，並適時償還債務。
我們持續積極管理我們自給自足、以客戶為中心的傳統保險子公司，包含包含在Closed Block分部中的長期照護保險、人壽保險與年金產品。我們的長期照護保險多年期在力費調降計畫持續為我們支持此戰略優先目標的最主要工具。我們預估已達成約34.5 十億美元的累計經濟效益，以淨現值計算為

paragraphs: 您應謹慎考慮下列風險。這些風險可能重大影響本公司業務、營運結果或財務狀況，導致本公司普通股交易價格重大下跌，或使本公司實際結果與預期結果或任何向前看聲明所表達的結果有重大差異。這些風險並非唯一，且本公司所面臨的其他風險包括，但不僅限於，「向前看聲明警示」部分所提及的因素，以及本年度截至2025年12月31日年度10-K形式年度報告其他部分所描述的業務風險。
下列為影響本公司的重大風險總結，並受下列完整說明所限制。上述任何風險或未知風險與不確定性之發生，可能對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
•新業務線或新產品與服務，例如本公司與CareScout所進行的業務，可能無法成功，或可能使本公司面臨額外風險。
•本公司可能因與預估與精算假設有所偏差或其他原因，而需提高備抵項目，這可能會對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
•若本公司業務所使用之模型不準確，可能會對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
•本公司對固定收益與權益證券之評價使用之方法、估計與假設可能有所變動與不同解釋，這可能會導致投資評價之變動，進而對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
